layout: summary + report header + one case file per case + run-log + journal-common + one journal file per read frame
note: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 cases erase.character (ECH ESC[3X) and erase.screen.scrollback (ED 3 ESC[3J), graded by the twenty-first layered collector extension. Stored state and actual saved lines only; the pinned pixel/query paths never carry a verdict and are not qualified.

context.clipboard: armed synthetic App-private storage only; no native interchange or OSC52 read permission
context.privateClipboardReferenceScope: selected App/VT observational reference inputs; not complete App closure or binary-source attestation
context.terminalOutput: parent-verified -opost through owned suites and private stock close; exact original kernel mode restored before done
context.ownedInputPolicy: one declared Avalonia event at a time in the proved disposable local pane; raw child stdin plus a post-action FIFO ordering reply; modes restored before teardown
context.ownedMetadataPolicy: paired private main-screen cells, bounded host metadata and actual UI controls; prepared baseline restoration plus verified disposable teardown
context.ownedSavedPolicy: paired owned active-screen facts and source-known restoration witnesses; no direct inactive-bank inspection
context.ownedResizePolicy: parent-selected App resize in proved private pane; independent kernel geometry and -opost; original grid restored before stock
context.pixels: nonce-bound owned offscreen renders; fixed synthetic phases, retained PNGs and render context; no live desktop timing
context.grading: versioned collector extension; pinned termless criteria replayed on parent-observed cells; not stock output
context.sgrColors: layered versioned collector extension; pinned reset/standard-color termless criteria replayed on parent-observed stored attributes and palette indices; not stock output
context.sgrClosure: layered versioned collector extension; pinned termless criteria sgr.blink, sgr.overline and sgr.underline.color replayed byte-exactly on parent-observed stored blink flag, explicit overline boolean and stored underline color with reset, decoy, independence and sibling-shared color controls; sgr.underline.color is graded from its own reads, never from the sibling sgr.underline-color-rgb verdict; no blink timing, rendering or App-resolved color; not stock output
context.charEdit: layered versioned collector extension; pinned character-editing termless criteria (editing.insert-chars with the explicit-1 ICH spelling, editing.delete-chars with the explicit-1 DCH spelling, editing.repeat-char with REP count 3) replayed on parent-observed stored ASCII cells, cursor and stored attribute details, with unmodified-seed, other-count-spelling, wide-row, right-edge, REP-after-barrier and attribute controls; REP graphic and repeat sent in one fenced write; created-blank and repeated-cell attributes observed not required; the pinned pixel/query paths never measure cells and are not qualified; no Unicode, wide-cell or combining editing; not stock output
context.charsets: layered versioned collector extension; pinned charset termless criteria (charsets.utf8, charsets.dec-special, charsets.dec-line-drawing, charsets.g0-g1-switching) replayed byte-exactly (UTF-8 text, escape designations and shift controls untouched) on parent-observed decoded physical cells from complete stored cell details (never attribute strings or UTF-16 offsets), the cursor and neutral stored attributes, with ASCII, designation, invocation, uppercase and lowercase restoration-witness controls; the pinned terminal pixel capture and cursor-query paths are never verdicts and are not qualified; no glyph, pixel, font, keyboard, locale or platform claim
context.eraseAttrsRegion: layered versioned collector extension; pinned termless criteria erase.el-with-attrs (EL with the omitted parameter over a measured SGR 42 background: the erased cell (0,0) reads blank with the same App-resolved background RGB as the X it replaced) and erase.ed-scroll-region (ED with the omitted parameter, margins 3;10 and the cursor at row 2: the preceding row KEEP! survives and the target cells read blank) replayed byte-exactly on the disposable App main screen and graded from parent-observed stored cells, App-resolved colors, the cursor, margins, mode flags and history, with a colored-X seed proof, pen and margin restoration witnesses, a full-screen control against accidental whole-screen clearing, resolved-color versus stored-representation comparison and current-pen versus preserved-background controls (observed, not required) and a marker fill recording where ED stopped relative to the margins (observed, not graded; no clipping claim); the pinned terminal cursor-query paths never carry a verdict and are not qualified; no rendered-appearance claim; not stock output
context.savedReset: layered versioned collector extension; pinned termless criteria modes.alt-screen.exit (the seeded ?1049 roundtrip), modes.altscreen-47, modes.altscreen-1047 (inconclusive by design in the pinned probe), reset.sgr (a case separate from sgr.reset) and reset.decaln (cell 0,0) replayed byte-exactly on the disposable App main screen and graded from parent-observed stored cells, cursor, active-buffer flag, margins, mode flags and history; the visible-buffer effect contracts for ?47 and ?1047 are separately identified Ntilde observations beside the preserved pinned verdicts; active-screen reads only, no direct inactive-bank inspection; reset.method, RIS and the pinned DECALN pixel path are not claimed
context.eraseCharsHistory: layered versioned collector extension; pinned termless criteria erase.character (ECH ESC[3X, explicit count 3, over ABCDE at column 0) and erase.screen.scrollback (ED 3 ESC[3J after rows+2 line feeds) replayed byte-exactly on the disposable App main screen and graded from parent-observed viewport text, stored cells and attributes, cursor, margins, modes, active buffer and the actual ordered saved lines and count, with erased-range, retained-cell, wide-row, oversized-count, right-edge, attribute, ordered-history, CSI 2J, ordinary-scrolling, empty-history and regrowth controls; ECH spellings other than the pinned one are observed, not graded; physical rows only; the pinned pixel/query paths never carry a verdict and are not qualified; ASCII only; not stock output
context.attrRect: layered versioned collector extension; pinned termless criteria editing.deccara (ESC[1;1;3;5;7$r, set inverse over rows 1-3 columns 1-5 of aaaaaZ/bbbbbY/cccccX), editing.decrara (ESC[1;1;3;5;7$t, toggle inverse off the same seeded area) and editing.decsace (inconclusive by design in the pinned probe: it only feeds ESC[2*x and reports consumption) replayed byte-exactly on parent-observed stored cells, cursor and stored attribute details; the pinned verdicts are preserved and the separately identified effect contracts grade the attribute change itself with default-stream versus rectangle extent controls (DECSACE 0, 1 and 2), set/clear/toggle operand controls, preserved text, colors and current pen, outside-area controls, second-application restoration and extent-restoration witnesses; the extent setting is not readable from the App, so it is observed only through behavior; stored state only, no rendered appearance, no stock grades
context.scrollback: layered versioned collector extension; the nine pinned scrolling/history termless criteria (scrollback.accumulate, total-lines, scroll-up, reverse-index, scroll-down, set-region, alt-screen, decstbm, decstbm-reset) replayed byte-exactly on a measured reset main screen and graded from parent-observed viewport text, actual scrollback lines and count, margins, active screen, modes, cursor and stored attributes, with empty-history, pre-overflow, region-confinement, wrong-direction, no-op, whole-screen, alternate-screen isolation and unreset-region controls; three pinned probes are null by construction and the contract measurement beyond them is recorded as a divergence; ASCII only; not stock output
context.lineEdit: layered versioned collector extension; pinned line-editing termless criteria (editing.insert-lines with ESC[1L, editing.delete-lines with ESC[1M, each at row 2 column 1 over four seeded rows) replayed byte-exactly on parent-observed stored cells of the whole screen, cursor, App-stored margins, origin and insert mode and stored attribute details, with no-op, count-spelling (observed), full-height boundary, scroll-region, origin-mode and attribute controls; stored ASCII state only, the pinned pixel path never carries a verdict and is not qualified, scrollback observed on the alternate screen only
context.eraseDisplay: layered versioned collector extension; pinned erase-in-display termless criteria (erase.screen.below with ED 0, erase.screen.above with ED 1, erase.screen.all with ED 2, all explicit-parameter) replayed byte-exactly on parent-observed stored cells, cursor, stored attribute details, buffer state and saved lines, with unmodified-seed, other-spelling (omitted, explicit 0/1/2), full-screen fill, boundary, bold-seeded attribute and main-screen history controls; background-color erase observed not required; the pinned pixel capture path is capture-only upstream and not qualified; CSI 3J not graded; not stock output
context.eraseLine: layered versioned collector extension; pinned erase-in-line termless criteria (erase.line.right with the omitted-parameter spelling, erase.line.left with EL 1, erase.line.all with EL 2) replayed byte-exactly on parent-observed stored cells, cursor and stored attribute details, with unmodified-seed, other-spelling (omitted, explicit 0/1/2), wide-row and bold-seeded attribute controls; background-color erase observed not required; the pinned pixel capture path is capture-only upstream and not qualified; not stock output
context.sgrReset: layered versioned collector extension; pinned selective-reset termless criteria (sgr.selective-reset.underline via SGR 24 and sgr.selective-reset.inverse via SGR 27) replayed byte-exactly on parent-observed stored flags, exact underline style, stored colors and overline, with no-op, full-reset, wrong-reset and DECSCNM controls; underline-color behavior observed not required; rendered appearance not claimed; not stock output
context.underlineResolved: Ntilde extension controls (not terminfo.dev cases, no pinned probe, no collector extension): the opt-in App-reported resolved underline color (readScreen includeResolvedUnderlineColors) compared with an independent expectation derived from stored underline state, the recorded palette binding and contracted OSC 4 constants, for indexed, literal and default-inheritance underlines with an OSC 4 mutation and its OSC 104 restoration; theme-resolution stage only; rendered appearance is not claimed
context.sgrUnderlineColor: layered versioned collector extension; pinned underline-color termless criteria (sgr.underline-color-indexed, -rgb, -reset; the aggregate sgr.underline.color is not qualified) replayed on parent-observed stored underline style and color index/literal/default with parent-derived resolved RGB and an OSC 4 mutation control; colon forms are ungraded controls; rendered underline appearance not claimed; not stock output
context.sgrUnderline: layered versioned collector extension; pinned underline-style termless criteria (sgr.underline.double via SGR 21; sgr.underline.curly, .dotted, .dashed via SGR 4:3, 4:4, 4:5) replayed on parent-observed stored underline flag and exact stored style; SGR 4, 4:1 and 4:2 are labeled controls without a grade; stroke appearance not claimed; not stock output
context.truecolorFinding: Ntilde finding (not a terminfo.dev case, no pinned probe, no collector extension): five exact direct-RGB values on fg/bg graded from parent-observed stored literal bytes and App-resolved RGB bound to the per-frame recorded palette, with an indexed positive control, an OSC 4 mutation of the aliased entry and its restoration; no pixels
context.sgrTruecolor: layered versioned collector extension; pinned truecolor termless criteria (sgr.fg.truecolor, sgr.bg.truecolor; semicolon 38/48;2;r;g;b form only) replayed on parent-observed stored literal bytes (palette index and default marker cleared) with App-resolved RGB bound to one recorded palette/theme; no pixels; not stock output
context.sgrPalette: layered versioned collector extension; pinned bright, 256-color and default-color termless criteria (sgr.fg/bg.bright, .256, .default) replayed on parent-observed stored palette indices, default markers and literal bytes with App-resolved RGB bound to one recorded palette/theme; no pixels; not stock output
context.sgrAttrs: layered versioned collector extension; pinned SGR attribute termless criteria (underline.single, inverse, faint, hidden, strikethrough) replayed on parent-observed stored flags and underline style with DECSCNM, neutral-baseline and reset controls; stored state only, no pixels; not stock output
context.sgrRgb: layered versioned collector extension; pinned named-color RGB termless criteria replayed on parent-observed App-resolved colors bound to one recorded theme state; not stock output
context.resolvedColors: opt-in readScreen projection resolved in the App rendering layer; storage-to-theme resolution stage, one coherent render snapshot; no pixels
context.cells: private AgentHost readScreen; nonce-bound pane; separate ASCII cell-state suite
context.attributes: separate ASCII SGR flags and palette-index suite
context.cellDetails: separate stored ARGB/underline and rendition/charset suites; no theme resolution or pixels
context.cursorModes: stored cursor style/blink/default/visibility; pristine owned DECSTR cleanup, no host appearance or blink phase
